entries.name: Ruby

entries.ready_note: ruby and ruby-rake from the runtime list; Ruby programs run as ordinary processes. No SDK surface.

entries.name: PAImaging
entries.note: Photo imaging framework (bundle com.apple.photo). The reference index lists no binary for it and the dyld shared cache is not materialised on this host, so the code could not be read. No BifrOSt counterpart; the photo app does its own image work.

entries.name: PAImagingCore
entries.note: Core of the photo imaging framework (bundle com.apple.photo). Same limits as PAImaging: no readable binary on this host, and no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: PCCAgentClient
entries.note: Client for the Private Cloud Compute agent extension, which sends requests to the vendor's server-side model hosts. BifrOSt runs its assistant locally, and this client has no meaning without the vendor's servers.

entries.name: PCCAgentClientCommon
entries.note: Shared code of the Private Cloud Compute agent client (bundle com.apple.cloudos.PCCAgentClientCommon). It only reaches the vendor's server-side model hosts, so it has no meaning on BifrOSt.

entries.name: PDS
entries.note: Bundle com.apple.PDS with no readable code in the index or on this host. Its purpose could not be determined from the Info.plist or the neighbouring rows, so it stays an OS item.

entries.name: PDSAgent
entries.note: Agent for the PDS framework with a Core Data model (Model.momd). The model's entities were not readable on this host, so the job is not determined and it stays an OS item.

entries.name: PIP
entries.note: Picture-in-picture geometry is in pip.rs: the shrunken picture's size, the corner it rests in, and where a dragged picture snaps. Remaining: the shell must draw the picture above other windows, which this file does not do, and the wiring is not yet tested on the lab machine.

entries.name: PIRGeoProtos
entries.note: Protocol buffer definitions for a geo service (bundle com.apple.PIRGeoProtos) with no code beyond the signature. The service they describe was not identified from the index, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: PackageKit
entries.note: System updates and installs go through pacman, which the shell calls and reports as a source. Not covered: a package installer format (.pkg), the install-script service the reference runs in its XPC helper, and install receipts.
entries.ready_note: System updates and installs go through pacman (shell/pacman_update.rs). No .pkg installer format, install-script service or receipts.

entries.name: PackageUIKit
entries.note: Build the package install interface: a per-package progress sheet and a confirmation before scripts run. backup_page.rs notes that pacman reports no progress to the shell, so the progress needs a pacman hook or a log reader first.

entries.name: PacketFilter
entries.note: Partial: a read-only firewall view in the sysinfo app (Firewall category, firewall_rows) shows the nftables or iptables rules that are loaded and says when none are. Not built: any settings page or rule writes, so the user cannot change the packet filter from BifrOSt.
entries.ready_note: Read-only firewall view in the sysinfo app (firewall_rows) lists loaded nftables/iptables rules. No rule writes or settings page.

entries.name: PacketParser
entries.note: Packet parsing library (bundle com.apple.clitest.PacketParser) with no readable code on this host. The packet capture on BifrOSt is tcpdump, but this parser's API was not identified, so the purpose is not determined.

entries.name: PanicHelper
entries.note: User-space crash reports from systemd-coredump, read through coredumpctl, appear in the Console diagnostics view. Not covered: kernel panic capture, which needs a kdump setup that BifrOSt does not ship.
entries.ready_note: systemd-coredump reports read via coredumpctl appear in the Console diagnostics view. Kernel panic capture is not covered.

entries.name: PanicProcessingSupport
entries.note: Support code for processing kernel panic dumps (bundle com.apple.DumpPanic.PanicProcessingSupport). BifrOSt has no kernel dump path yet, so the job stays an OS item until a kdump setup exists.

entries.name: PaperBoardUI
entries.note: The home screen composes its wallpaper as a view in the scene, with a blurred dock backdrop. Not covered: the separate renderer service the reference runs in its XPC helper, and dynamic wallpapers.
entries.ready_note: Home screen composes its wallpaper as a scene view with a blurred dock backdrop (scene.rs, 6 tests). Dynamic wallpapers are not built.

entries.name: ParavirtualizedANE
entries.note: Paravirtualised neural engine for guest virtual machines in the vendor's virtualisation stack. BifrOSt has no neural engine hardware to expose to guests.

entries.name: ParsecModel
entries.note: Model for the vendor's server-side search suggestions (a Cohorts model in Resources). The feature depends on the vendor's online search service, which BifrOSt does not mirror.

entries.name: ParsecSubscriptionServiceSupport
entries.note: Subscription support for the vendor's online search service, which sends queries to the vendor's servers. BifrOSt keeps search local in its quick search index.

entries.name: ParsingInternal
entries.note: Internal parsing library at version 0.0.1 with no readable code and no public role in the index. Its purpose is not determined, so it stays an OS item.

entries.name: PartnerVisualSearch
entries.note: Visual search through third-party partner services (bundle com.apple.GenerativeFunctions.PartnerVisualSearch). It sends image content to outside services, and BifrOSt does not send user images off the machine.

entries.name: PlatformSSO
entries.note: Bundle com.apple.PlatformSSO is the enterprise single sign-on extension for managed devices; it needs the directory enrolment and device management that BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: PlugInKitDaemon

entries.ready_note: Process table with one process per extension and host key (extension_process.rs). Enablement state is in memory only.

entries.name: PodcastsFoundation

entries.ready_note: Podcast library in podcasts.rs; playback and chapters in media.rs and chapters.rs.

entries.name: PoirotAnalytics
entries.note: PoirotAnalytics is the reference's usage analytics client, which collects events for the vendor's analytics and experimentation service; BifrOSt runs no such service.

entries.name: PoirotBlocks
entries.note: PoirotBlocks is the query-block layer of the reference's analytics pipeline (the Poirot family, next to the Poirot experimentation extension in the image); it only serves the vendor's analytics service.

entries.name: PoirotSQLite
entries.note: PoirotSQLite is the local event store of the reference's Poirot analytics pipeline, which buffers usage events for the vendor's analytics service; BifrOSt has no such event pipeline.

entries.name: PoirotSchematizer
entries.note: PoirotSchematizer defines the event schemas of the reference's Poirot analytics pipeline for the vendor's analytics service, so it has no meaning for BifrOSt.

entries.name: PoirotUDFs
entries.note: PoirotUDFs holds the user-defined functions the reference's Poirot analytics queries call; it only serves the vendor's analytics pipeline.

entries.name: PommesRankingCore
entries.note: Bundle com.apple.metadata.PommesRankingCore ranks metadata results; search_ranking.rs ranks search results with rules, and the reference's learned ranking model is not built.

entries.name: Portrait
entries.note: Bundle com.apple.portrait.Portrait is probably the portrait-mode depth effect; the binary is not extracted and no BifrOSt module does depth effects, so the row stays os.

entries.name: PortraitCore
entries.note: Kept os. Name suggests portrait lighting for the camera pipeline, but the reference index holds only the bundle shell and no binary, so the purpose is unconfirmed; the camera and depth-blur rows in render/ are the nearest BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: PostSiriEngagement
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json
entries.ready_note: Apps declare [[intent]] tables in manifest.toml and serve them on their control socket. Search and the Shortcuts action library list and run an installed app's shortcut intents (shell::intents::runnable_shortcuts). The assistant answers with intent cards that run only after the user confirms them, and reads answers aloud when Speak Answers is on. Voice recognition is not built: nothing turns speech into an intent request, so Siri's spoken requests are not covered.

entries.name: PosterFoundation
entries.note: Kept os. Likely the lock screen poster model, but the reference index holds only the bundle shell and no binary; BifrOSt's wallpaper pages are the nearest counterpart and do not cover posters.

entries.name: PosterFuturesKit
entries.note: Kept os. Likely lock screen poster content, but the reference index holds only the bundle shell and no binary; purpose unconfirmed.

entries.name: PosterModel
entries.note: Kept os. Likely the lock screen poster data model, but the reference index holds only the bundle shell and no binary; purpose unconfirmed.

entries.name: PowerExperience

entries.name: PowerLog
entries.note: Battery level history: the shell samples the battery every five minutes and charts 24 hours in Settings. The reference's on-device power-log telemetry database and its collectors are not mirrored.
entries.ready_note: Battery level history sampled every five minutes and charted for 24 hours (battery.rs), with power_sources in the SDK. No on-device power-log database.

entries.name: PowerUI
entries.note: Battery readout and time estimates in the shell and the Battery settings page. The reference's learned time-to-empty model is not shipped, so estimates come from the kernel's supply readings.
entries.ready_note: Battery readout and time estimates from kernel supply readings (power_supply.rs) and the Battery settings page. No learned time-to-empty model.

entries.name: PowerlogControl
entries.note: Control interface for the power-log telemetry collector. It only drives that collector, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: PowerlogCore

entries.name: PowerlogDatabaseReader
entries.note: Reader for the on-device power-log telemetry database. BifrOSt keeps no such database; battery history is the shell's battery.log.

entries.name: PowerlogFullOperators
entries.note: Telemetry operator set that the power-log collector loads in its full configuration. It exists only for that vendor collector.

entries.name: PowerlogHelperdOperators
entries.note: Telemetry operator set that the power-log collector loads for its helper daemon. It exists only for that vendor collector.

entries.name: PowerlogLiteOperators
entries.note: Telemetry operator set that the power-log collector loads in its lite configuration. It exists only for that vendor collector.

entries.name: PredictedContextAlgorithms

entries.name: PreviewShellKit

entries.ready_note: Shell Quick Look service covers file previews (quick_look.rs). Developer preview windows are not shipped.
